text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho, a goal once set aside. 
Having managed to get in condition in 
time, she was ready to challenge it, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash is already looking toward her 
next goal. Even if it is the Kikuka Sho, 
she will simply deliver results as always.
